text.en:
📋 The Matrix demo trading contest: rules and prizes

To be ranked you need at least 30 trades on 10 different days. A trade with a notional value under 500 demo USDT does not count.

Prizes total $2,000 across 33 winners, in USDT: 1st 500, 2nd 300, 3rd 200, places 4 to 13 get 50 each, places 14 to 33 get 25 each.

Taking part is free, and no real deposits are accepted during the contest.

The virtual balance is 10,000 demo USDT in the futures account. It has no money value, cannot be withdrawn, transferred or sold, and is not topped up during the contest.

🎥 How to join video: https://youtu.be/0tzXQOBiQyo

🔗 matrixcex.com

An educational demo contest, not investment advice.
